title: Vafambi Vemunda Wemiti Yakasvibira
intro: Kare kare, vanhu vaviri vaichengeta nyika dziri pedyo. Nzira dzavo dzaive dzakabatana, asi mwoyo yavo yaivatungamirira kunzvimbo dzakasiyana zvikuru. Mumwe aifamba nenzira yakatwasuka, mumwe akapinda murima rekuramba. Unogona here kutsanangura chakavanzika chevaviri ava vanochengeta goho?
clues: Ndaiva nezvirimwa zvakawanda, goho rakanaka raishamisa maziso evaoni.
Muvakidzani wangu aive nezvakawanda kupfuura ini, asi ndaishuva mugove wavo kupfuura wangu.
Ndakakurudzira kuti tiparadze zvirimwa zvavo zvachose, kuti tisimbise zvese zviri pasi pangu.
Ndakaparadzawo goho rangu, ndichiparadza zvese zvandaironga.
Ndakamira ndisina simba sezvo zvirimwa zvangu zvaioma uye pfuma yangu yakabva yava guruva muusiku humwe chete.
Handina mugove muhupenyu hweramangwana, uye nzvimbo yangu yekupedzisira yakava gomba remoto unopfuta.

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Kuparadzwa kwakakwana kwezvirimwa zvose muhupenyu huno
Kubudirira kwenguva pfupi kunoteverwa nemoto usingaperi
Kudzorerwa kunoshamisa uye mubairo wakapetwa kaviri
outcome.answer: Kuparadzwa kwakakwana kwezvirimwa zvose muhupenyu huno

verse: Then they approached one another, blaming each other. (68:30)
